HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Indian Traditional Calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Say Indian Traditional Calendar has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Indian Traditional Calendar to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Indian Traditional Calendar with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calendar.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Panch- mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Panch- mahabhoot.
   B. Use Panch- mahabhoot to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Say Panch- mahabhoot has no place in daily life.
